shortDescription: Madison Dearborn Partners (MDP) has agreed to acquire holding firm The Marygold Companies AMEX:MGLD in an all-cash transaction that values the company at $2.00 per share, representing a 100% premium over its closing price on September 24, 2026.Upon completion, Marygold will transition to a privatel…

children: in an all-cash transaction that values the company at $2.00 per share, representing a 100% premium over its closing price on September 24, 2026.
Upon completion, Marygold will transition to a privately held company and cease trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
Following the close, MDP and incoming leadership plan to execute Marygold's previously announced transformation strategy, refocusing the core business entirely on its wholly-owned subsidiary, USCF.

USCF is a prominent commodity-focused ETF manager overseeing approximately $6B in assets under management across key asset classes, including crude oil, natural gas, copper, broad commodity indices, and equity income strategies.
As part of the transaction, ETF industry veteran Tim Rotolo will take over as Chief Executive Officer of Marygold, succeeding outgoing President, CEO, and Chairman Nicholas Gerber.

MDP's investment provides strategic capital and resources to drive product innovation, distribution, and marketing for USCF. Partnering with incoming CEO Tim Rotolo and USCF's investment team, MDP aims to scale the ETF platform through operational optimization, enhanced sub-advisory partnerships, and client-focused growth strategies.
The transaction is expected to close in the first half of 2027 or earlier.

The Marygold Board of Directors has unanimously approved the deal, and key shareholders, including Nicholas Gerber, who holds approximately 75% of Marygold's outstanding voting shares, have signed voting and support agreements in favor of the merger.

title: Madison Dearborn partners to acquire The Marygold in $2.00/share all-cash buyout
